name: python-setuptools
description: Python setuptools, with 'import distutils' routed to its copy; needed by gobject-introspection's build
build_commands: printf '%s\n' "# setuptools' .pth file does this in a site dir; on PYTHONPATH only sitecustomize runs." "import os" "if os.environ.get('SETUPTOOLS_USE_DISTUTILS', 'local') == 'local':" "    __import__('_distutils_hack').add_shim()" > $TSI_INSTALL_DIR/lib/python-setuptools/sitecustomize.py
